_readme: German (Handelsregister, Amtsgericht Charlottenburg) and Portuguese register entities named 'Point Nine', read 2026-09-26 from North Data's free entity pages (search 'Point Nine' over five result pages plus name-qualified searches; the schema.org foundingDate, the address, and the free event history). Shareholder tables and fund portfolios sit behind North Data's paywall and were not read; the 'register_mentions' field carries the free 'Erwähnungen' block (which companies' shareholder lists name the entity, and the participations stated in its annual accounts). Load-bearing facts: Point Nine Capital Fund I GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 43145 B) was entered 2009-10-28 as 'Team Europe Ventures Fund GmbH & Co. KG' (GP Team Europe Ventures Verwaltungs GmbH; 2 individual and 11 corporate limited partners on 2009-12-10), renamed 2011-09-01, GP changed to Point Nine Verwaltungs GmbH 2014-11-18; Point Nine Co-Invest I GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 43129 B) was entered 2009-10-23 as 'Team Europe Ventures Investment Board GmbH & Co. KG' and renamed 2012-04-04. Namesakes found and unrelated: Point Nine Data Trust Ltd (Cyprus), Point Nine Clothing Ltd, Point Nine Recruitment Ltd, Pointnine Capital Ltd (Cannock, 2025), and the 'Two/Five/Eight Point Nine' UK companies.
